_comment: Twilio SMS/voice notification credentials, resolved through tools/lib/resolve-credential.cjs. Every field is individually optional here (twilio-creds.js decides which combination is usable) since Twilio accepts either an Account SID + Auth Token pair OR an API Key SID + Secret pair.

TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID.description: Twilio Account SID (AC... prefix). Preferred auth pair with Auth Token; can also be discovered at runtime from an API Key pair.

TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Twilio Auth Token, paired with Account SID.

TWILIO_API_KEY_SID.description: Twilio API Key SID (SK... prefix) -- alternative auth to Account SID + Auth Token.

TWILIO_API_KEY_SECRET.description: Twilio API Key Secret, paired with TWILIO_API_KEY_SID.

TWILIO_FROM_NUMBER.description: Twilio phone number you own (E.164). If unset, tools auto-discover a capable owned number at runtime.

TWILIO_OPERATOR_PHONE.description: Your own personal phone number (E.164) -- the notification destination. Never hardcode this; always resolve it.
